title: A Deterministic Security Runtime for LLM Agents on MPI and Batch-Scheduled HPC Systems: Consensus-Governed, Hardware-Rooted Supervision of Every Rank
abstract: arXiv:2610.33318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents launch simulations on high-performance computing (HPC) systems, where one sbatch or mpirun can commit thousands of node-hours and a forged result can cost lives. Of 23 surveyed systems, none supervises the running job, and none holds when the control host is compromised. We fix both. Enclawed, our deterministic security runtime for AI agents, has until now served a single user; this work makes it a distributed runtime for parallel HPC and agent swarms. The Enclaweder, our hardware root of trust, keeps a compromised host from becoming a catastrophe. A launch gate decides every launch by policy alone, refusing what it cannot parse. Once the job runs, a swarm chain grants short leases against signed heartbeats and evicts on evidence, and a supervisor around every rank pauses it when its lease lapses and kills it on tampering. Each node signs with its Enclaweder's key, so the host can forge none of it. Enclawed

translated_title: 面向MPI与批调度HPC系统上大语言模型智能体的确定性安全运行时：基于共识治理与硬件信任根的逐进程监督
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体会在高性能计算（HPC）系统上启动仿真任务，一条sbatch或mpirun命令就可能占用数千节点小时的计算资源，而一份伪造的结果可能危及生命。在调研的23个系统中，没有一个对运行中的作业进行监督，也没有一个能在控制主机被攻陷后仍然保持安全。我们同时解决了这两个问题。Enclawed是我们面向AI智能体的确定性安全运行时，此前仅服务于单用户；本工作将其扩展为面向并行HPC与智能体集群的分布式运行时。Enclaweder是我们的硬件信任根，可防止被攻陷的主机演变为灾难。启动门仅依据策略对每次启动做出裁决，拒绝其无法解析的内容。作业运行后，集群链依据签名的心跳授予短期租约并在有证据时予以驱逐；围绕每个进程（rank）的监督器在租约失效时暂停作业，在检测到篡改时终止作业。每个节点使用其Enclaweder的密钥进行签名，因此主机无法伪造其中任何内容。
tldr: 该论文提出Enclawed——首个面向MPI与批调度HPC系统上LLM智能体的分布式确定性安全运行时，通过硬件信任根Enclaweder、策略驱动的启动门、基于签名心跳与短期租约的共识治理以及围绕每个进程的监督器，实现了即使控制主机被攻陷也能对每个运行中的进程进行不可伪造的持续安全监督。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Enclawed, a distributed deterministic security runtime for LLM agents on MPI and batch-scheduled HPC systems, which combines a hardware root of trust (Enclaweder), a policy-driven launch gate, consensus-governed short leases with signed heartbeats, and per-rank supervisors to deliver forge-proof, continuous supervision of every running rank even when the control host is compromised.
